note: Curated list of primary laws and regulators. Sources disagree on some dates and regulator names, so each entry should be confirmed against the official text before it is relied on.

countries.name: Bahrain

laws.title: Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 30 of 2018)
laws.status: In force since 1 August 2019; amendments to 1 January 2024 consolidated by MOLA

regulator.name: Ministry of Justice and Islamic Affairs (designation differs between sources; verify)

countries.note: The Arabic Official Gazette text is the authoritative version.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia

laws.title: Personal Data Protection Law (Royal Decree M/19 of 2021)
laws.status: Enforceable from 14 September 2024 after a transition period

laws.title: Implementing Regulations and Personal Data Transfer Regulations
laws.status: Issued by SDAIA in September 2023; supplemented by later SDAIA rules and guidelines

countries.note: Breaches must be reported to SDAIA within 72 hours, per the implementing regulations as summarised by secondary sources.

countries.name: UAE

laws.title: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data
laws.status: Federal law; does not cover free zones with their own regimes (e.g. DIFC, ADGM); enforcement dates differ between sources

regulator.name: UAE Data Office (verify its current web address)

countries.note: Check the Data Office's status and the Executive Regulations before relying on compliance deadlines.

countries.name: Qatar

laws.title: Law No. 13 of 2016 Concerning Privacy and Protection of Personal Data
laws.status: In force; publication dates differ between sources (late 2016 to early 2017)

regulator.name: National Cyber Governance and Assurance Affairs (NCSA)

countries.note: Qatar does not publish official English translations; English texts are unofficial.

countries.name: Oman

laws.title: Royal Decree 6/2022 Promulgating the Personal Data Protection Law
laws.status: Issued 9 February 2022; enforceable from 2023; full enforcement reported from February 2026

regulator.name: Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT)

countries.note: The law has been amended since 2022; check the consolidated text on decree.om.

countries.name: Kuwait

laws.title: CITRA Resolution No. 26 of 2024 (Data Privacy Protection Regulation)
laws.status: Published February 2024; replaces Resolution No. 42 of 2021; grace period ended around 2025

regulator.name: Communications and Information Technology Regulatory Authority (CITRA)

countries.note: Covers telecom and IT service providers licensed by CITRA, not every business.

countries.name: Mozambique

laws.title: Draft Personal Data Protection Law (INTIC public consultation, 2025)
laws.status: Draft, not enacted at the last check; reportedly being prepared for Parliament

regulator.name: Proposed National Data Protection Authority (in the draft)

countries.note: Mozambique is not a GCC member. Its status should be checked against official Mozambican sources.
